sentences.text:
This is an application under Sec.439 Cr.P.C. for bail and the offences alleged are under Secs.302/376/201, I.P.C.
2.
Heard Mr. S.K. Sahu, learned counsel for the Petitioner as well as Mr. D. Mohanty, learned Additional Government Advocate for State-Opposite Party.
3. It is submitted on behalf of the Petitioner that, he is inside custody since 8.7.2019 and till date trial is not completed.
It is further submitted that, there is no direct material against the Petitioner and the case is based on circumstantial evidence.
4. Mr. D. Mohanty, learned A.G.A. opposes the prayer for bail of the Petitioner.
5. Upon going through the statements of witnesses, Viz.P.W.1 to 10, as the copies of the depositions are produced in course of Signed by: BASANTA KUMAR BARIK Location: High Court of Orissa,
and considering the circumstances of the case including the post-mortem report as well as the DNA profile report, I am not inclined to release the Petitioner on bail.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail is rejected.

6. However, considering the period of detention of the Petitioner inside custody, learned trial court is directed to complete the trial as expeditiously as possible, preferably by end of March 2025 and report compliance.
